commit.message: Merging in improvements from Tot.
Merging in improvements from Tot.
Added .DS_Store
Started thinking about horizontal rules.
Started working on a scanner for horizontal rulers.
Started rendering rules. Experimenting with putting rules back into Markdown.

Horizontal rules can now round trip, but there are copy & paste issues.

Custom NSTextAttachment attributes do not get copied to the clipboard.

Experiment to see if putting an archive on the pasteboard would work.

Probably, yes.
Added custom TextView that supports copy & paste of horizontal rules.
Improved round-trip, copy/paste, and rendering of horizontal rules.
Fixed issues with copy/paste. Improved archiving and representation.
Code cleanup.
Updated tests for horizontal rules.
Added test notes.
Testing programmatic rich text updates. Added prefix/suffix check on Markdown.
Simplified the generation of horizontal rules in the attributed string.
Cleanup.
Started refactoring the pasteboard code to handle attachments.
More simplification on pasteboard support.
Started looking at code to ensure that text attachment is surrounded by newlines.
Added checks to ensure that rule attachments are always wrapped in newlines.
Moved and renamed the horizontal rule text attachment.
Updated to use MarkdownHorizontalRuleTextAttachment.
Changes to build on iOS.

Bringing in improvements from Tot:

• Added parameter for processing block elements.
• Updated drawing on iOS.
• New tests to test processing of block elements.
• ViewController configuration for block elements.
Improved handling of horizontal rules.

+//
+//  HorizontalRuleTextAttachment.h
+//  SampleApp
+//
+//  Created by Craig Hockenberry on 5/20/25.
+//  Copyright © 2025 The Iconfactory. All rights reserved.
+//
+
+#import <Cocoa/Cocoa.h>
+
+NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_BEGIN
+
+@interface HorizontalRuleTextAttachment : NSTextAttachment <NSSecureCoding>
+
+- (instancetype)initWithFont:(NSFont *)font color:(NSColor *)color thickness:(CGFloat)thickness hasPadding:(BOOL)hasPadding hasSpaces:(BOOL)hasSpaces range:(NSRange)range;
+
+@property (nonatomic, assign, readonly) NSRange range;		// NOTE: this value does not update as text is edited: consider it a temporary variable.
+
+@property (nonatomic, strong, readonly) NSColor *color;
+@property (nonatomic, strong, readonly) NSFont *font;
+@property (nonatomic, assign, readonly) CGFloat thickness;	// "***" = 2.0, "---" = 1.0
+@property (nonatomic, assign, readonly) BOOL hasPadding;	// "  ***  " or "  ------  "
+@property (nonatomic, assign, readonly) BOOL hasSpaces;		// "* * *" or "--- - ---"
+@property (nonatomic, assign, readonly) NSInteger width;	// "***" = 3, "-----" = 5, "-- - --" = 7
+
+@end
+
+NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END
